title: Editable per-page voice coach pickers
summary: Records and recommendation result cards: voice coach pickers are scroll-editable again. Count sessions use each panel's local picker values (target reps, interval, one-more, hold duration), not My Page Settings.
testFocus: Records card + recommendation result: scroll all four pickers. Start count — session uses scrolled values, not Settings. Change Settings separately — does not override in-page picker until card remounts. Two record cards can have different picker values.

deploy.frontend: GitHub Pages via push to main

asIs: History/recommendation pickers read-only; count used Settings store values.
toBe: Pickers editable per card/page; count uses that panel's local picker state.
